verdict.rationale: The Innovator Founder visa page on gov.uk publishes exact per-person application fees split by where you apply: £1,357 outside the UK and £1,693 to extend or switch inside the UK. So a founder can see the statutory amount on the service's own pages rather than through a contact form. The faster-decision option has no published price; applicants are only 'told if you can when you apply'. Missing for 10: published amounts for the priority/faster-decision fee and other ancillary charges (e.g. endorsement or health surcharge), and independent corroboration that the published fees match what is charged.
